Job Title: Data Engineer 
 
Job Category: Information Technology 
 
Time Type: Full time 
 
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: None 
 
Employee Type: Regular 
 
Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10% 
 
Type of Travel: Continental US 
 
 
* * * 
 
 
 The Opportunity: 
The Data Engineer designs, builds, and sustains the data infrastructure and pipelines that power analytics, reporting, automation, and mission‑critical decision‑making. This role ensures that data is reliably ingested, transformed, governed, and delivered across secure enterprise systems. The Data Engineer partners closely with software engineers, analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders to provide high‑quality, accessible data that enables operational and strategic outcomes.

 Responsibilities: 

 Assembling large, complex sets of data that meet business requirements from internal and external environments
 Building required infrastructure for optimal extraction, transformation and loading of data from various data sources using AWS, SQL, and other technologies
 Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT data pipelines that support analytical, operational, and AI/ML workloads
 Develop and maintain data models, schemas, and storage structures optimized for performance and usability
 Implement data integration frameworks and APIs to enable secure data movement and interoperability
 Collaborate with software engineers, analysts, and data science teams to ensure workflows are well supported
 Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize pipelines, ensuring high availability, data quality, and adherence to governance requirements
 Document data architectures, processes, and engineering standards; contribute to continuous improvement within Agile/DevOps environments
 Operate within compliance, security, and information assurance requirements, particularly in regulated or classified environments

 Qualifications: 

 Required:  

 Minimum 5 years’ experience as a DBA, Developer, or related field
Commitment to documentation, process improvement, and high quality engineering practices
 Understanding of data quality, data lineage, and governance in enterprise environments
 Proficiency with at least one programming language used in data engineering (Python, Java, etc.)
 Proficiency in SQL, data modeling, and ETL/ELT development
 Experience building and maintaining data pipelines, integrations, and workflow orchestration in secure environments.
 Strong experience working with large, complex datasets across multiple systems
 Experience with relational database and data warehouse technologies.
 Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) for data engineering workloads
 Ability to collaborate with cross‑functional engineering and analytics teams to resolve technical issues
 
 Desired: 

 Bachelors or Masters in information systems, computer science, or related field
 Experience supporting DoD, Intelligence Community, or other regulated mission environments
 Excellent attention to detail
 Strong ability to multitask
 Strong communication and collaboration skills
 Ability to troubleshoot complex data issues

 
 
 
- 
 
 What You Can Expect: 
  A culture of integrity. 
 At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.
 An environment of trust. 
 CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
 A focus on continuous growth. 
 Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.
 
 

 Pay Range : 
 There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.
 
 The proposed salary range for this position is: 
$67,800 - $142,200 
 
 
 
 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
